item.title: New Mexico Environment Department to begin PFAS clean up at Curry County dairies
item.description: CLOVIS, N.M. (KRQE) – New Mexico Environment Department officials said they will clean up per- and polyfluoroalkyl (PFAS) contamination in eastern New Mexico. item.title: Record heat, high fire danger develops by Saturday
item.description: Record high temperatures build across New Mexico by Saturday. A cold front will bring a brief cooldown Sunday and Monday, but an unprecedented stretch of March heat is likely next week. Warmer weather returned to eastern New Mexico Thursday, with highs climbing back into the 70s. Northeast New Mexico is nearly 30° warmer than yesterday. [...]

item.title: I-40 at Atrisco Vista reopens after five vehicle crash
item.description: ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. (KRQE) – Traffic is flowing on I-40 at Atrisco Vista after a five-vehicle crash on I-40. The Bernalillo County Sheriff's Office said no major injuries were reported, but the interstate was shut down, so crews could move the vehicles out of the way. BCSO said all lanes have now reopened.
